meta.name: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
meta.description:
Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, has enrolled in the Ninja Academy to learn the ways of the ninja. Now, as a series of mysterious events unfolds, Boruto’s story is about to begin!

Shows: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow, The Last: Naruto the Movie (English Dubbed), Boruto: Naruto the Movie (English Dubbed), Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom, Naruto Shippuden: The Movie (English Dubbed)
Available on: Pluto TV
